cases.prompt: Build a local counter app named CounterProbe with one top-level dashboard, increment and reset actions, an observable view model, synthetic sample data, and unit tests for increment/reset.

Build a local reading-list app named ReadingProbe with a top-level searchable list and a book detail screen, three synthetic books, mark-finished behavior, and unit tests for filtering and marking finished. Use in-memory state; no account or network.

Build a local habit dashboard named HabitProbe with a top-level dashboard and settings screen, three synthetic habits, completion counts, and unit tests for completing and resetting habits. Use in-memory state; no account or network.
